notes: RECOVERY HISTORY: Setup, Recovery history brings in the old debtors schedule's bills at their full amounts and every recovery on them, with the old receipt and cheque numbers and payment dates, so each balance shows how it was reached. No balance changes: every debtor is checked before and after, and the import can be undone. Recoveries brought forward never count as cash, banking or in the accounts journal. NEW REPORT: Bills and recoveries. Also carries 1.3.1: the training copy button on Help, two-copy receipts, bank statement matching. Installing: the books are upgraded when the app opens; no figure changes. Take a backup first: Setup, Backup, Back up now.
